blocks.text: Open TTSBard with a hotkey, type a phrase and send it - the application speaks it. Keep typing or return to your previous application. TTSBard brings speech, on-screen text and sound reactions together for everyday communication and streaming.
Type a phrase and hear it spoken
Press <font name='Consolas' color='#416B96'>Ctrl+Shift+F3</font> (customizable): the window opens above other applications, ready to type.
Type a phrase and press <font name='Consolas' color='#416B96'>Enter</font> - TTSBard speaks the text.
Depending on your Quick editor setting, sending hides the window or returns focus to the previous application.

blocks.title: Communication and content
blocks.lead: One quick workflow for two everyday needs
bullets: Communication: text-to-speech in games and voice chats for people who communicate by typing.
Streaming and content: speak your own phrases, display subtitles and trigger sound reactions.

blocks.title: Voices and audio processing
blocks.lead: Cloud and local options in one application
bullets: Silero Bot works through your Telegram account, shows remaining speech quota and supports SOCKS5 and MTProxy connections.
Piper uses ready-made voice models installed on your computer. Each model is a separate voice.
OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Fish Audio and a local HTTP server compatible with TTS Voice Wizard are also supported.
Adjust pitch, tempo and volume; remove noise with DeepFilterNet and process speech with an equalizer, compressor and limiter.
Audio cache retains synthesized phrases: matching repeats need no synthesis wait and consume no additional TTS-service quota.

blocks.title: Editor
bullets: Tabs. Text survives restarts. Choose speech, OBS, Twitch and/or VRChat destinations separately for each tab.
History and autocomplete. Suggestions use earlier phrases. Reinsert text or replay speech from the last 500 phrases.
Spellchecking. Russian typos are underlined, with corrections available by right-click.
Compact and Mono. Keep a compact editor with tabs or a single text field in Mono. Resize the window; its view and size are remembered.
Fonts. Editor text font and size are independent of the interface.
Quick inserts. Short codes expand into saved phrases and names.
Text preparation. Russian numbers become words; RUAccent places Russian stress and resolves words whose spelling is identical.

blocks.title: Audio outputs
blocks.lead: You and your conversation partners hear the speech
bullets: Send speech to speakers or headphones and simultaneously to a virtual audio cable, such as VB-CABLE or VoiceMeeter.
In games and Discord the virtual cable acts as a microphone, letting others hear TTSBard.
Speaker and virtual microphone volumes are independent. Default-device selection follows Windows output changes.

blocks.title: Communication and streaming
blocks.lead: Share phrases and typing state with other applications
bullets: Display spoken phrases in OBS and style the overlay to match your stream.
Send phrases to Twitch Chat as your user or bot account.
VRChat shows completed phrases above your avatar and a typing indicator while you enter text.
Exclude TTSBard windows from OBS and Discord capture.
In VTube Studio, make the avatar react or show a scene item while you type.

blocks.title: Playback and Sound panel
blocks.lead: Use key actions without returning to the main window
bullets: A separate playback window stops, pauses or repeats speech.
Assign sounds to Sound panel keys and organize reactions into sets.
Assign individual keys to opening TTSBard windows, controlling playback or capturing screen text. NumPad, F1-F24 and navigation keys are available by default; optionally allow any key.

blocks.title: Text from other sources
blocks.lead: Speak more than manually typed text
bullets: Web input form. Open it in a browser, Steam Overlay during a game, or another device on the same local network.
Screen OCR recognizes a selected area for speech or editing.
LunaTranslator integration receives clipboard, screen or game-engine text to speak visual novels and other games.

blocks.text: TTSBard runs on Windows 10 and 11 and is distributed under GPL-3.0-only.
